reviewAnswers.finding: Boundary regression against main just below 1280 for a wider details line. With whose-turn badge + one label + Route + Subscribers (607px) at 1279 the line just fits the title row on the head (title block 200 + state 382 + rail 607 + gaps = the 1205px card) and the flex-1 min-w-[12rem] title block keeps only its minimum: h1 70px, clamped ('Migr at...'); on main the same line wraps under the title (state box 42px wider) and the h1 is 643px. Probe across 1100-1280: head squeezes only at 1271-1279 for this line; main never below 1280. Without the label (badge + Route + Subscribers, ~525px) BOTH builds squeeze: head 81-130px at 1230-1279, main 69-88px at 1260-1279. So the mechanism is pre-existing on main (the sub-xl title row: title flex-1 basis 0 with a 12rem minimum, sharing the row with state and details whenever they fit); the head shifts the squeeze band ~30-40px toward narrower windows and, for lines >= ~565px, opens a band main never reached. observations: Finding for the architect (not blocking on the review answers as stated): below 1280 the title shares a row with the state controls and the details line whenever the line's content fits; the title block is flex-1 with basis 0 and a 12rem minimum, so in the band just below the fit threshold it keeps only ~70-130px. Main has the same band (badge + Route + Subscribers: 69-88px at 1260-1279). The PR's 42px narrower priority pill moves the band ~30-40px toward narrower windows, and for details lines of ~565px or more (badge + one label + Route + Subscribers is 607px) it opens a band (1271-1279) where main never squeezed. A possible fix is a larger title minimum below xl or forcing the details line onto its own row when the title would drop below a readable width; the reviewer's grow concern itself is resolved.

The implementer's 'unclipped at all three widths' depends on the specific 31-character title's glyph widths: at 1200 the title h1 is 210px on the head, and a 33-character title clamps there. The lock is still a valid regression lock for the grow change (it fails with grow restored, per the implementer, and 210 > 168 on main).
Line 4 placement unchanged: Version / Name version share the tab row from 1536 and wrap under the tabs at 1280 with both rails open and at 390.
The isolated toolchain, scratch main build, servers, Postgres container, throwaway specs and e2e/test-results were removed after the run; web/dist stays untracked.
